listing.name: 4D Driving (FM Towns Marty rerelease) — pc-4ddriving (vs-sr-dev)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Races/replay/editor/music/audio comparisons; no completed full-game checks; the distinct Marty edition preserved. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: FM Towns Marty Japanese 4D Driving rerelease HMD222A own12-trackdisc plus your own font ROM. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: fmtownskit own-disc extraction/static generation then build/rt/4ddriving, local user-disk save/a. These are manual setup instructions. Portcove does not manage this download or confirm setup or gameplay.

warnings: Races/replay/editor/music/audio comparisons; no completed full-game checks; the distinct Marty edition preserved. These are the project’s reports; Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
